title: Following the course of people with isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder
summary:
This monocentric research project aims to thoroughly analyze individuals in the early stages of Parkinson's disease to better understand its initial progression.
For this purpose, longitudinal data from routine clinical examinations are collected and supplemented by study-specific assessments of both motor and non-motor functions. In addition to clinical-behavioral assessments, biomaterial is collected to correlate biological and clinical changes. This comprehensive characterization of individuals with isolated REM-sleep behavior disorder is intended to serve as a resource for national and international collaborative projects. A local comparison group, consisting of age- and sex-matched healthy control participants and individuals with a de novo diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease, is also recruited to undergo a similar assessment.
conditions: Primary Parkinson's syndrome with no or minimal impairment

interventions.name: Individuals with isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder will undergo study assessments (tablet/computer-based assessments, sensor-based assessments, biomaterial collection, clinical tests such as neuropsychological and motor function tests) that will be repeated annually on a long-term open-ended bas
People with a de novo diagnosis of Parkinson's disease will undergo the same study assessments as the group of people with isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder, but only once.

Healthy control subjects will undergo the same study examinations as the group of people with isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder and the group of people with a de novo diagnosis of Parkinson's disease, but only once.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Individuals with isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age between 45-85 years
- Ability to give informed consent
- Polysomnographically diagnosed REM sleep behaviour disorder

Subjects with de novo diagnosis of Parkinson's disease:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age between 45-85 years
- Ability to give informed consent
- Diagnosis of Parkinson's disease within the last 3 years

Healthy control subjects:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age between 45-85 years
- Ability to give informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Individuals with isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder:
Exclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, multisystem atrophy

Individuals with a de novo diagnosis of Parkinson's disease:
Exclusion criteria:
- Dementia

Healthy controls:
Exclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of REM sleep behaviour disorder, Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, multisystem atrophy or other neurodegenerative disease
